response:
Sure, matey! Here's a little pirate song for ye:

(Chorus)
Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum,
We're the crew of the Black Swan,
Sailing the seas, under the moon,
With a treasure map and a compass, we're on the run!

(Verse 1)
We hoist the sails when the wind is right,
With a parrot on our shoulder, we're a sight,
Through the fog and the storm, we'll find the gold,
With a cutlass in our hand, we're bold!

(Chorus)
Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum,
We're the crew of the Black Swan,
Sailing the seas, under the moon,
With a treasure map and a compass, we're on the run!

(Verse 2)
We've got a captain with a peg leg and a hook,
And a first mate with a beard that looks like a brook,
We're singing sea shanties, we're dancing in the rain,
With a map in our hands, we'll find the treasure again!

(Chorus)
Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum,
We're the crew of the Black Swan,
Sailing the seas, under the moon,
With a treasure map and a compass, we're on the run!

(Bridge)
We'll plunder ships and we'll steal their gold,
We'll drink and dance, we'll sing and hold,
Our tales of the sea, they'll be told,
Of the Black Swan, and the crew bold!

(Chorus)
Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum,
We're the crew of the Black Swan,
Sailing the seas, under the moon,
With a treasure map and a compass, we're on the run!

Outro:
So hoist the sails, and let the wind take us,
To the islands where the treasure's waiting for us,
With a song in our hearts, and a map in our hands,
We're the crew of the Black Swan, sailing the land and the sands!
